skill.summary: Synchronize TickTick (Dida) and Google Tasks bidirectionally, including list/project mapping, task content sync, completion sync, and smart-list export (Today, Next 7 Days, All). Use when users ask to set up OAuth, run or schedule sync, fix mismatched/deleted/completed tasks, or troubleshoot Google Calendar duplicate behavior caused by due-date handling.

latestVersion.changelog: Globalized setup scripts, removed Chinese README, and improved path portability for OAuth token setup.
